name: Ōi (Fukui, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōi town emblem in green and blue: a green ring above blue stylised waves.
history: Municipal flag of Ōi, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 March 2006.

features.role: Ōi town emblem — a green ring above blue stylised waves
